title: 77 MINUTES
source: User prompt, FACTS section, copied verbatim on 2026-10-20. These are the only facts the film may show.
facts: Ahmad Yoosuf. From Adirampattinam, a coastal town in Thanjavur district, Tamil Nadu. Based in Chennai.
Family are scholars of Islam; most stop formal school around class 10 or 12. First in the family to attend college.
Father studied until third grade; owned more than 2,000 books; died 1 July 2019, aged 43. That morning his brother said: "Everything is over. Change your dress."
Maternal grandmother died October 2018. Cyclone Gaja, 15 November 2018: the roof of their house landed on the next street. Paternal grandmother died December 2018, 45 days after the first.
Ages 9 to 15, before a phone, his father's library was how he "left his world".
Grades 7 to 10: first rank in all 18 exams. Final school year: sick in bed two of the last four months; finished with 75 percent.

2022: applied to Harvard, MIT, Princeton and Yale alone; no counsellor, no SAT, no mentor. Wrote on Discord: "I'm not a fast writer. It took nearly half an hour to write the above statement." A stranger reviewed the essay once, harshly and usefully; later replies were "no i'm busy" and "No I'm busy"; his reply: "Ok😢". Rejections followed.
2022 letter to a Harvard professor ended: "I took 77 minutes for writing this message to you (#hardwork😅). Period."
Rejected for more than 400 roles at about 100 companies. Most applications written on a laptop released in 2010.
Journal, 27 August 2023, age 18: "Well said and well thought is better than well done according to my intuition which seems ridiculous but does not hinder me from practicing that terrible idea."
Tamil proverb: ஏட்டுச் சுரைக்காய் கறிக்கு உதவாது (A gourd drawn on paper won't cook a curry).

Work: Vaakku, a Tamil speech-to-speech system that called voters, shown to district officials (vaakku.org). statement2xl, an engine that turns bank statements into spreadsheets (statement2xl.com). ayyayo, voice-to-code for children who think in Tamil (ayyayo.app, ayyayo.ai); "ayyayo" is Tamil for "oh no"; first used for an agent that found lost photos. Tagline: "ayyayo. just say it."
No other numbers, names or dates exist for this film.

items.script_line: I woke up at five thirty, prayed, and put on my school uniform.
Around seven, my brother knocked on my door.
For three years I filled notes with plans, rules and resolutions.
